attributes.name: alive-color
attributes.description: SVG fill color for living cells.

attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.description: Starts automatic generation playback after initialization or reset when present.

attributes.name: background
attributes.description: SVG background color behind the grid.

attributes.name: cell-radius
attributes.description: Corner radius of each cell in SVG units; negative values are clamped to zero.

attributes.name: cell-size
attributes.description: Width and height of each cell in SVG units, clamped to at least 1.

attributes.name: dead-color
attributes.description: SVG fill color for dead cells.

attributes.name: grid-color
attributes.description: SVG stroke color of the cell grid lines.

attributes.name: grid-stroke-width
attributes.description: Width of the grid lines in SVG units, clamped to at least 0.1.

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: Delay between automatic generations in milliseconds, clamped to at least 16.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Optional title displayed above the game controls.

attributes.name: padding
attributes.description: Space around the grid in SVG units; negative values are clamped to zero.

attributes.name: preset
attributes.description: Built-in starting pattern: glider, blinker, toad, beacon or gosper-gun. An inline tp/game-life program takes precedence.

attributes.name: preset-height
attributes.description: Positive number of grid rows when using preset; absent or invalid uses that preset's height.

attributes.name: preset-width
attributes.description: Positive number of grid columns when using preset; absent or invalid uses that preset's width.

attributes.name: preset-x
attributes.description: Integer horizontal offset of the preset pattern in grid cells; defaults to the preset position.

attributes.name: preset-y
attributes.description: Integer vertical offset of the preset pattern in grid cells; defaults to the preset position.

attributes.name: steps
attributes.description: Number of generations to compute before the first display and after reset. Zero or a negative value keeps the starting grid.

attributes.name: wrap
attributes.description: Connects opposite grid edges so cells at a boundary interact with cells on the opposite side.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-game-life>` element implements the <tp-icon name="game-life" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Game of Life functionality: conway's Game of Life component.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Toggle cells to prepare a pattern. |
| Using the component | Step advances one generation; Play starts continuous evolution and changes to Pause. |
| Using the component | Reset restores the starting state. |
| Play / Pause | Starts or pauses the simulation. |
| Step | Advances the simulation by one generation. |
| Reset | Restores the initial pattern. |
| Download | Saves the current pattern as a file. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
